tool_spec.name: query_pricing_data
tool_spec.description: Query all retail analytics data using natural language. Covers SKU pricing, margins, competitors, stock levels, promotion campaigns (ROAS, lift, budget, performance), customer loyalty (LTV, churn risk, segments, tiers), and returns (return rates, margin erosion, reasons). Use this for ANY data question.

tool_spec.name: execute_sku_action
tool_spec.description: Execute an action on a specific SKU. Records the action in the audit trail. Actions: REPRICE (change price), REPLENISH (reorder stock), MONITOR (add to watch-list), ESCALATE (flag for senior review). Always confirm with user before executing.

tool_spec.name: get_category_health
tool_spec.description: Get category-level KPI summary including total SKUs, overpriced/underpriced counts, margin percentage, inventory value, and counts needing action. Optionally filter to a single category.

tool_spec.name: get_pricing_alerts
tool_spec.description: Get SKUs needing immediate price review sorted by gap severity. Returns alerts with AI recommendations. Optionally filter by category.

execute_sku_action.name: EXECUTE_SKU_ACTION(VARCHAR, VARCHAR, DEFAULT VARCHAR, DEFAULT VARCHAR)
